brainlife.desc: Averaged MEG/EEG responses (evoked/ERP) as MNE-Python Evoked objects in ave.fif, one or more conditions.
brainlife.name: neuro/meeg/mne/evoked
brainlife.readme:
To be edited by Saseed

**Use for:** Input for source estimation, forward modelling (sensor info) and ERP inspection.

**Not for:** Noise covariance estimation except as a last resort.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 4 Apps, output of 3 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meeg.mne.evoked.json

files.desc: MNE Evoked FIF (ave.fif) with one or more condition averages.

identifying_risks: MNE measurement info in the evoked FIF can carry subject_info, meas_date and digitised head points.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level M/EEG derivative linkable through a participant code.
sharing_cautions: Run mne anonymize (info) before sharing outside a controlled project.
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if the measurement info keeps subject_info (name, birth date) or meas_date.

inputs_of.name: Compute Noise Covariance
inputs_of.purpose: noise covariance from empty-room raw, epoch baselines or evoked data

inputs_of.name: Make Forward Solution
inputs_of.purpose: MEG/EEG forward solution from source space, transform and BEM

inputs_of.name: Read info
inputs_of.purpose: dumps evoked measurement info to info.txt

inputs_of.name: Source Estimate
inputs_of.purpose: applies an inverse operator to evoked data, giving source estimates

intended_use: Input for source estimation, forward modelling (sensor info) and ERP inspection.
not_suitable_for: Noise covariance estimation except as a last resort.

outputs_of.name: Average ERP (MNE)
outputs_of.purpose: averages selected conditions into an evoked response
